overview: Based on the published agenda, the City of Mosinee Common Council scheduled a special budget meeting to hold a public hearing on the proposed 2027 budget and consider adoption of the budget through Resolution No. 2026-08. The meeting was also set to address building permit applications, employee holiday gift certificates, and modifications to the city's labor agreement with the police association.

discussions.item: City of Mosinee 2027 Budget Public Hearing
discussions.body: The Common Council was scheduled to hold a public hearing on the proposed 2027 budget for the City of Mosinee. This hearing was set to allow community members to provide input before the council considers formal adoption of the budget.

The council was scheduled to discuss and consider action on Resolution No. 2026-08, which would adopt the 2027 budget for the City of Mosinee and authorize the levy of taxes for the upcoming fiscal year.
The council was set to discuss and take possible action on building permit applications. Specific details regarding the applications were not provided in the agenda.
The council was scheduled to discuss and consider action regarding city employee holiday gift certificates, though specific details about the proposal were not included in the agenda.

discussions.item: Mosinee Professional Police Association Labor Agreement Modification
discussions.body: The council was set to discuss and potentially take action on modifications to the labor agreement with the Mosinee Professional Police Association, which covers the period from January 1, 2023 to December 31, 2026. The council may have convened into closed session pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes 19.85(1)(e) to discuss this matter.
